About.Title: About
About.Description: Tracks accepted Star Citizen contracts from Game.log and mobiGlas, measures their duration and profit per hour.
About.Disclaimer: Unofficial fan-made tool. Not affiliated with Cloud Imperium Games. Reads only log files, game data and the screen – never game memory.

Mode.Hint: AUTO = the contract ends by itself according to Game.log (completed, abandoned, logout…). MANU = it ends only with the buttons in the app, at the moment you click; the end time from the log is shown only as a note. Click to switch.

Edit.ErrNumber: Reward, fee and reputation must be whole numbers.
